notes.title: Acid Change:
notes.notes:
Acid Changed from Max Health Damage to Armor Reduction.
the max health damage was too strong in higher difficulties and too weak in lower difficulties.
Switch to Armor Reduction keeps it strong and usable in all difficulties

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/voidwave/voidwave.github.io/refs/heads/main/img/armorinhealthbar.png[/img]

-Armor as a white bar on top of the health bars. 0-99% damage reduction.
